hypotheses.D1_each_function_has_finite_downstream_e: Every selected head/function-word intervention has mean final-logit KL above 1e-5.
hypotheses.D2_same_variable_has_distinct_functions: Median absolute global cosine between different heads' finite logit-effect vectors is below 0.30.
hypotheses.D3_function_is_more_stable_than_invocati: Median within-head near/far effect cosine exceeds median cross-head all-route cosine by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.D4_weight_distinction_survives_nonlinear: At least four of six cross-head effect pairs have absolute cosine below 0.30.
